$description: Per-theme mega-menu colors, pushed into Penpot's theme/light and theme/dark sets by build-penpot-tokens.js. Same reason as buttonColors.json: a token that lives only inside the Penpot file is deleted by the next import, because import replaces same-named sets and theme/light + theme/dark are both generated. The Mega-menu board on the Components page binds to these, so losing them breaks the component. Names are emitted verbatim, NOT under the color.* prefix the semanticColors entries get. The CSS in blocks/main-nav.css computes these live with color-mix() in oklab against --color-text / --color-bg / --color-accent-blue; the hexes below are the flattened result at the current palette and can drift if the palette moves. Two colors the panel uses are already real tokens and are deliberately absent here: the row label is color.text and the icon/count hover is color.orange.500.
